rule: Advanced Mechanical Essence decomposes into intermediate 2. A true intermediate-2 item is one whose copper, iron, gold and redstone all reach refined items (ingots, dust, nuggets) in exactly two recycles. Depth is counted on those metals; stone, quartz, plastic and the like that come out earlier don't fail an item.
method: The recycle trees were derived by a script that applies RecyclingRules to every recipe JSON in the vanilla 26.1.2 client jar, the NeoForge 26.1.2.109 universal jar (whose recipes replace vanilla's of the same id) and every jar in the instance's mods/ folder. Tag ingredients take their first item, NeoForge difference ingredients their first item left. perItemTier1 multiplies each branch by 0.25 per recycle. perItemTier1Craft (only where it differs) lets the player craft a copper, iron or redstone block back to 9 at full yield instead of recycling it. The packing amendment re-ran the same model over every item, kept the true intermediate-2 ones, and marked each whose tree has a storage block as a node (an item whose recipe takes one ingredient that a recipe makes back from it). Mix figures sum each item's perItemTier1 and apply the decompose's quarter.

candidates.goldNote: Its gold comes out as nuggets. Theurgy liquefies gold ingots, raw gold and gold ores but no nugget (theurgy-26.1.2-neoforge-1.116.1.jar!/data/theurgy/recipe/liquefaction/alchemical_sulfur_gold_from_{ingots,raw_materials,ores}_gold.json), so the nuggets reach Theurgy only through 9 nuggets -> 1 ingot (minecraft_26.1.2_client.jar!/data/minecraft/recipe/gold_ingot_from_nuggets.json), a compress recipe. Under the packing rule its gold does not count; its iron and redstone do. Trace anyway: 1/32 nugget per item at tier 1.

candidates.name: Rune of Sacrifice II
candidates.note: The only true intermediate-2 item found that carries whole gold ingots with no packing: 2 per rune, from the Rune of Sacrifice inside it. Its first recycle also returns 4 netherite scrap, hellforged parts and cobblestone, so a mix with runes hands out netherite scrap at 8 times the rate of gold (0.25 scrap and 0.03 gold per rune per essence at tier 1). The Rune of Sacrifice's blood-orb ingredient (neovitae:orb_tier, tier 1) comes back as that ingredient's first item, which the script could not resolve; it is listed as an orb. If Neo Vitae becomes a challenge's mod, its items in Advanced's mix need a second look under ADR 0006.

mixes.name: Pipeworks
mixes.notes: Unchanged by the exclusion: no storage blocks, so every figure is what the Recycler really returns. The balanced pick: the best route C of the three. Byproducts: 36 cobblestone, 21.5 planks and 12 string in its full tree; the pumps' first recycle returns pistons and buckets, the outlets' dispensers. Pulls in Pipeworks, usable as decomposed.

mixes.name: Outlets
mixes.notes: The most copper a clean mix carries: the Outlet's 4 copper is the best of any true intermediate-2 item without blocks or wax. Iron comes only from the two Pumps, which makes route A iron-bound almost as soon as copper (32 against 34) and route C slow. Byproducts: cobblestone (50 in the full tree), string from the dispensers' bows, planks.

mixes.name: Runes (gold)
mixes.notes: The Pipeworks mix with its Minecart with Hopper and Comparator traded for two Runes of Sacrifice II: the only clean mix that covers route A's gold. Gold is no longer the bound: 2 gold per Galvanic takes 32 essences, under copper's 46.5. The cost is iron (route C 131) and 0.5 netherite scrap per essence, plus hellforged parts, deepslate and Neo Vitae's tabulae and an orb. One rune instead of two, with the Minecart back, keeps route C at 58.3 but makes route A gold-bound at 64.

openQuestions: Storage blocks: decided. An item that relies on a packing recipe is excluded from the mix (packingRule). Waxed copper items are a new edge: no packing, but an axe unwaxes a placed one for free, a step the Recycler never sees. Are they excluded like blocks (flagged: axe)?

Gold: the mix may carry it only from Neo Vitae's Rune of Sacrifice II (the runes mix), at the price of netherite scrap. Modular Routers' trace gold comes as nuggets and needs a compress recipe to reach Theurgy. Gold from outside the challenge mods is surveyed in gold-sources.md. Does the mix carry gold (runes) or leave it to a source outside the mix?

Full yield or tier 1: at full yield every figure is 64 times the tier-1 one (16 times where blocks are crafted). Tier 1 makes route B cost 110 to 230 essences per Galvanic. Should a balance pass size the mix on tier 1 and let higher-tier cores (#189) make it comfortable, or on a higher core's yield?

Bootstrap: the Recycler's parts (kubejs/server_scripts/decomposing.js) are assembled from pistons, hoppers and a comparator that decomposing by hand gives today. Recycling needs a Recycler, so a mix of Pumps and Outlets gives no piston until one is built. The parts' recipes would have to take the new mix's items as they are (a Pump, an Outlet, a Comparator).

Usable as decomposed: a mix item works as is. Pumps and Outlets are Pipeworks' fluid blocks, a Hopper Minecart a hopper. Is that a reward or a cost? The inert alternative, Cut Copper, is now excluded (packing).
Mix size: today's mix holds four items. Every essence-per-Galvanic figure scales inversely with the mix's count; the three proposals are all 8 items.

FTB Materials: its smelting recipes from dust to vanilla ingots (ftb-materials-26.1.2.6.jar!/data/ftbmaterials/recipe/copper_ingot_from_smelting_copper_dust.json) carry an ftbmaterials:components_available condition. If they load, a copper ingot recycles into FTB's copper dust (smelting first, then id order puts ftbmaterials before minecraft), not raw copper. It changes nothing above refined, but matters if route B wants raw copper from recycled ingots (at a quarter, 0.75 sulfur per ingot, worse than liquefying the ingot).

Tag order: a tag ingredient returns its first item. The script took NeoForge's and vanilla's order (minecraft:copper_ingot first in #c:ingots/copper, oak planks first in #minecraft:planks). A mod adding to a tag first would change what comes back. To check in game with EMI's recycling view.

Craftworks: the Assembler runs grid recipes as they are, so they stay crafting to the Recycler. Only Craftworks' own five recipes are assembling, and of the candidates only the Assembler and Refiner are made that way.

Netherite: a rune mix hands out 0.5 netherite scrap per essence at tier 1, and a recycled rune is the only way the pack has to get scrap before the Nether. Is that acceptable, or does it rule the runes out?
Neo Vitae's role: if it becomes the life challenge's mod, can a Neo Vitae item sit in Advanced's mix, when recycling it returns Neo Vitae intermediates (tabulae, a blood orb)?
packingRule: Maintainer's decision for #209: a candidate whose depth or yield relies on a packing recipe, a storage block (9 ingots <-> 1 block) or any other compress/uncompress pair, is excluded from the mix. Blocks are not a band step. The Recycler's code does not change; this only decides which items may be in the mix. The mix stays true intermediate 2: exactly two recycles to refined. A candidate is marked excluded: "packing" when a storage block (copper, iron, redstone or netherite) is a node of its recycle tree; one that already failed keeps passes: false and is marked too, so no figure of it is used.

Excluded: Cut Copper is a copper block.

exclusionCost: Only two copper carriers survive: the Outlet (4 copper) and the Pump (3 copper, 4 iron). Before, the Steam Turbine carried 36 and Cut Copper 9. The best essences per Galvanic go from A 22.3 / B 109.9 / C 55.2 (recycled blocks) or A 6.6 / B 32.8 / C 22.8 (crafted blocks, what a player would really have done) to A 34.1 / B 168.5 (Outlets) and C 58.3 (Pipeworks). Against the crafted-block figures that is about 5 times the essence for routes A and B and 2.6 times for C. Route B, the copper grind, is the one that hurts: 168 essences per Galvanic at tier 1 at best. The waxed copper items would win some of it back (a Waxed Copper Chest carries 8 copper) if the axe is ruled no shortcut: 6 Waxed Copper Chests and 2 Pumps give A 32 (iron-bound) / B 93.6.
